    Survey Snapshot

    What 60 Users Told Us

    This audience is practical, trust-sensitive, and allergic to gimmicks. They want dependable payouts, real dollars, and proof before commitment.

    View full Maze report
    Priority check 0% Said "fun to use" matters
    #1 Priority 37% Reliable payouts — top-ranked by a wide margin
    Display preference 51% Prefer real dollar amounts over points
    Speed expectation 73% Expect payout in under 24 hours
    Acquisition trigger 35% Need "proof it pays" before trying a new app
    Payout method 69% Prefer PayPal — table stakes for launch

    Synthesis

    Where Team & Users Align

    Your feedback and the user data pointed the same direction on the things that matter most. Here's how they converged.

    Trust is the foundation
    5 of 6 of you rated trust "just right" on at least one direction.
    Users: 37% say reliable payouts are #1. 43% would leave if it feels scammy.
    Professional warmth, not playfulness
    EarnWise "too serious" (Aditya, Matt R). Savi "too cute" (Matt R, Matt T).
    "Fun to use" = 0% priority. 65% want reliability + value.
    Real dollars, always
    Valentina: "I love the opportunity to see the real balance in money equivalent."
    51% prefer dollar amounts. Only 11% want points.
    Goals over expense anchoring
    Matt T: "I don't like the references to gas and groceries. It adds to my stress."
    Users want to feel their time is worth it (28%), not be reminded of what they can't afford. Positive framing wins.

    Welcome

    Welcome — social proof and one-tap sign-up

    Why this screen exists
    35% of users need "proof it pays" before they'll try a new app.
    Valentina: "Colour scheme stands out from competitors." First impressions set the trust tone.
    EarnWise palette, social proof with a real dollar figure, and one-tap sign-up. Clean and credible from the first second.

    Trust & Value

    Trust carousel — real earnings, fast payout, no tricks

    Why this screen exists
    Top churn drivers: "feels scammy" (43%), "earnings too small" (52%).
    Team unanimously rated trust as critical across both directions.
    Matt T: "I don't like the references to gas and groceries. It adds to my stress." — so the carousel leads with goals, not expenses.
    3-slide carousel addressing the top three user concerns: real earnings, fast PayPal cashout, no tricks. Plus a real testimonial.

    Note: the placeholder icons will be replaced with illustrative animations in the final build.

    Conversational Profile

    Downtime habits
    Why this screen exists
    Corinna loved "When do you have time to play?" Personalization that feels like a conversation, not a form.
    4 conversational steps — feels personal like Savi, but streamlined like EarnWise. Each answer maps to personalization: downtime → activity picks, time → notifications, goal → progress ring.

    Home & Welcome Gift

    Home — $1 welcome gift, personalized first-day tasks

    Why this screen exists
    #1 churn driver: "earnings feel too small" (52%). 35% need proof it pays.

    $1.00 welcome gift visible immediately. Progress ring toward user-chosen goal. Today's picks personalized from profile answers.
